entries.title: Ezekiel 35:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Mount Seir - The Edomites, who inhabited it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Their iniquity - When their iniquity was punished on them, which brought them to final ruin.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: And blood - Thy guilt, and my just revenge of innocent blood. Hast not hated - Thou hast loved, rather than hated, blood - shed; therefore vengeance for it follows thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: That passeth out - All travellers that go to or from Edom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The whole earth - The inhabitants of all the countries round about thee. Rejoiceth - Is in peace and plenty.
